name: A Tasting Flight of Names
source:
In the hazy night of the city, a runaway slips into an unmarked shop, seeking its owner with a 'simple' request -- to steal away a name.

[From [url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/a-tasting-flight-of-names]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在城市朦胧的夜晚，一名逃亡者溜进一家没有标记的商店，寻找店主，提出一个“简单”的要求——偷走一个名字。

[来自[url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/a-tasting-flight-of-names]itch.io[/url]]
